reviews.title: Performance
reviews.comment: Here’s a detailed review for the be quiet! Pure Power 12 M 850W Power Supply: ⸻ The be quiet! Pure Power 12 M 850W is a premium PSU that strikes a strong balance between performance, quiet operation, and efficiency — perfect for high‑end gaming rigs, content‑creation PCs, or workstations that demand reliable power delivery. Build Quality & Design: Right out of the box, this feels like a well‑made unit. The chassis has a solid, premium feel, and the modular cabling system is well‑designed — letting you use only the cables you need, which keeps your build clean and improves airflow. The cables themselves are sturdy and flexible, making routing and cable management much easier than with cheaper PSUs. Performance & Stability: With 850 W of power, it provides more than enough headroom for most modern systems, including high‑end GPUs and overclocked CPUs. Power delivery is stable with minimal voltage fluctuation under load, which is vital for system reliability — no sudden spikes or drops even during intense gaming sessions or heavy workloads. Efficiency: The Pure Power 12 M series carries an 80 Plus Gold efficiency rating, meaning it wastes less power as heat and draws less from the wall compared to lower‑rated units. This translates to lower operating costs and cooler internal temperatures, which help overall system longevity. Noise & Cooling: As the brand name suggests, noise is impressively low. The PSU uses a high‑quality fan that stays whisper‑quiet across a wide range of loads. Even during demanding sessions, the fan curve keeps things calm, and the unit doesn’t add noticeable background noise to your build. Safety & Reliability: be quiet! includes all the essential protections (OVP, UVP, SCP, OCP, OTP, etc.), so your components are well‑protected against electrical irregularities. Combined with solid build quality and good thermal performance, this is a PSU you can install and forget without worry. Installation & Modular Cable System: The semi‑modular design is intuitive: essential cables are attached, and optional ones snap in as needed. This keeps clutter down and makes it easy to build neat systems, whether you’re experienced or building your first PC. Who It’s Best For: • Gamers & enthusiasts who run powerful GPUs or multiple drives • Content creators with high‑load workflows • Upgraders who want future headroom without replacing the PSU again soon • Anyone who values quiet operation and clean cabling Potential Downsides: • It’s premium‑priced compared to basic PSUs, but you’re paying for quality, efficiency, and quiet performance — and it shows. • If you run a very modest build, an 850 W unit might be more than you need, but for future‑proofing it’s smart. Overall: The be quiet! Pure Power 12 M 850W is an excellent choice for anyone who wants a reliable, efficient, and ultra‑quiet power supply that will power demanding systems with confidence. It’s one of those components that quietly does its job so you can focus on performance — exactly what you want from a PSU

reviews.title: Quiet, Powerful, and Well Designed
reviews.comment: The be quiet! Pure Power 13 M 850W power supply is an excellent unit. It runs ultra quiet even under load and provides plenty of power for demanding systems. The cable options are great and make for a clean build, and the unit itself looks sleek and well designed. Overall, a powerful, reliable PSU that performs exactly as expected.
reviews.author: MT

reviews.title: Great choice for my build
reviews.comment: I recently finished a new rig with an AMD 9900x and 5070 gpu. The gpu specs recommended a 650W minimum PSU but I figured I would go a bit higher and get a 850W supply. I could have sprung for the 1000W supply but it seemed unnecessary for my needs of light gaming and mostly office work. I did several hours of research of PSUs and BeQuiet! one was listed on several different lists as a top cost effective option. I liked that it was modular and came with a 12VHPWR port/cable which works for new gen GPUs. I didn't want to have to use an adapter and with my new build I was going for a minimal cable look. The install was super easy into my Antec C8 case and it runs very quiet. I have a total of 10 fans in my case as well and even under heavy load of gaming nothing makes much sound.
reviews.author: TrojanMan!

reviews.title: Great PSU!
reviews.comment: I purchased this to replace this awful Thermaltake Tough Power GF A3 PSU which was causing stability issues with my PC. This PSU works MUCH better than the TT. This PSU delivers nice, stable, and clean power to my hardware. It is also incredibly quiet. I never hear the fan even when I am gaming or stress testing my system. This will be my go-to when I start building PC to sell!
